statement: A unit's `thermo <name>;` is ignored in silence by the time-integrated driver: a copy of batch17_dilute_ergun_limit with a variant selected on a unit runs to exit 0 with output identical to the unmodified case and no line naming the variant (older silence: `thermo { bogus 1; }` is accepted on main).
The resolved view attributes a block inherited from the root through `inherits` to the sector's own file (Flowsheet::printFragmentView never sets the local file or inheritance).

The resolved view (and the result's thermoResolution) gives a catalogue pair's source as `inline` while the builder's own line names data/standards/parameters/NRTL/ethanol-water.dat (model5_nrtl_flash, unmodified).

Misleading view lines: a gammaGamma sector printed as `K-value world: gammaPhi`; a one-slot unit override attributed the whole equilibrium row; a sector view that never lists the units it serves; no view for an inline operation fragment, which the commit message claims.
A sector unit naming a variant defined in the case's root dictionary is refused with a sentence that is false for that file; it should name the sector file and say variants are not inherited.
An empty variant selected by a unit runs with no view and no `selected by` line, while the property binary prints one for the same variant.
A variant changing only a property's mixingRule fails with the generic `missing entry 'model'`; nothing says the property block is replaced whole.

A vapour-pressure pin is ignored by the reactive electrolyte engine (its own component copy, ThermoPackageBuilder.cpp:1247, :1303-1304) while the view prints `case pin`: flash12 copy, preferred `doubled` gives p_ethanol 0.0267482774966 atm, pinned `doubled` gives 0.0133741386148 atm, the unpinned value.

A salt's liquidHeatCapacity cannot take the several-laws grammar (ThermoPackageBuilder.cpp:767-768 hands the raw block on): a crystalliser11 copy refuses with a parser message and a pin can never reach a salt (SL-05 half closed).
A hard-domain refusal never names the law that covers the state: the remedy is stored in PropertyDomainError::remedy and no run-time printer reads it.

The view prints `soft ... (announced outside)` for laws whose type never reads the soft window (Vogel, Andrade), and nothing is announced outside it; keys a law type does not read are accepted silently.
pinLaw does not reset the 298.15 K datum-bridge cache (Component.cpp:1438/1508); harmless only while nothing resolves the bridge before the pin.
